[{"group":"UI","name":"Theme","source":"--!strict
-- HUD look (docs/DEFINICOES.md §3): dark translucent panels with a yellow corner tab (the
-- "cut corner"), a condensed military face for numbers and labels (Oswald) and a rough
-- display face for announcements (Bangers). Every HUD builds its panels and text through here.

local Theme = {}
local Tokens = require(script.Parent.Tokens)
local AssetView = require(script.Parent.AssetView)

Theme.TOKENS = Tokens
Theme.COLOR = Tokens.color
Theme.FONT = Tokens.font
Theme.image = AssetView.image
Theme.skinButton = AssetView.button

export type TextStyle = "label" | "heavy" | "display"

-- A TextLabel in the house style; `props` are applied last and can override anything.
function Theme.text(parent: Instance, style: TextStyle, props: { [string]: any }): TextLabel
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.TextColor3 = Theme.COLOR.text
	l.FontFace = Theme.FONT[style]
	l.TextScaled = true
	l.TextStrokeTransparency = Tokens.transparency.textStroke
	for key, value in props do
		(l :: any)[key] = value
	end
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

-- Styles a frame as a HUD panel: dark glass, thin light edge and the yellow corner tab.
function Theme.panel(frame: GuiObject, transparency: number?)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.COLOR.panel
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = transparency or Tokens.transparency.hud
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.ClipsDescendants = true
	AssetView.slice(
		frame,
		if (transparency or Tokens.transparency.hud) <= 0.15
			then "ui.panels.modal"
			else "ui.panels.hud",
		transparency
	)

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, Tokens.geometry.radius)
	corner.Parent = frame

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	stroke.Color = Theme.COLOR.text
	stroke.Transparency = Tokens.transparency.edge
	stroke.Thickness = Tokens.geometry.stroke
	stroke.Parent = frame

	-- A square turned 45° and clipped by the panel reads as a cut, highlighted corner.
	local tab = Instance.new("Frame")
	tab.Name = "CornerTab"
	tab.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	tab.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	tab.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Tokens.geometry.cornerTab, Tokens.geometry.cornerTab)
	tab.Rotation = 45
	tab.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.COLOR.accent
	tab.BorderSizePixel = 0
	tab.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
	tab.Parent = frame
end

-- Big action button (shop, class cards): yellow fill, dark heavy text.
function Theme.button(button: TextButton, family: string?)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = if family == "secondary"
		then Theme.COLOR.surface
		else Theme.COLOR.accent
	button.TextColor3 = if family == "secondary" then Theme.COLOR.text else Theme.COLOR.panel
	button.FontFace = Theme.FONT.heavy
	button.TextScaled = true
	button.AutoButtonColor = true
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, Tokens.geometry.radius)
	corner.Parent = button
	AssetView.button(button, family or "primary")
end

return Theme

-- Optional catalog art with native UI fallback while an image is unavailable/moderating.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Assets = require(script.Parent.Assets)
local Ids = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Art.AssetIds)

local AssetView = {}

function AssetView.resolve(key: string): string?
	return Assets.resolve(key, Ids)
end

function AssetView.image(parent: Instance, key: string, props: { [string]: any }?): ImageLabel?
	local uri = AssetView.resolve(key)
	if not uri then
		return nil
	end
	local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	image.Name = "Asset_" .. key
	image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	image.Active = false
	image.Image = uri
	image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
	image.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
	for name, value in props or {} do
		(image :: any)[name] = value
	end
	image.Parent = parent
	return image
end

function AssetView.slice(parent: GuiObject, key: string, transparency: number?): ImageLabel?
	return AssetView.image(parent, key, {
		Name = "AssetSurface",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		ZIndex = parent.ZIndex,
		ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice,
		SliceCenter = Rect.new(12, 12, 52, 52),
		ImageTransparency = transparency or 0,
	})
end

-- Keep the caption a separate GUI element: localized labels/prices remain readable even
-- when the texture changes. Native button remains the input target (including gamepad).
function AssetView.button(button: TextButton, family: string)
	if
		button:GetAttribute("AssetSkinned")
		or not AssetView.resolve("ui.buttons." .. family .. "-normal")
	then
		return
	end
	button:SetAttribute("AssetSkinned", true)
	button.AutoButtonColor = false
	local image = AssetView.slice(button, "ui.buttons." .. family .. "-normal")
	if not image then
		return
	end
	local caption = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	caption.Name = "AssetCaption"
	caption.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	caption.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	caption.ZIndex = button.ZIndex + 1
	caption.Active = false
	caption.Parent = button
	local hover, pressed, focused = false, false, false
	local function sync()
		local disabled = button:GetAttribute("AssetDisabled") == true
		local state = if disabled
			then "disabled"
			elseif pressed then "pressed"
			elseif focused then "focused"
			elseif hover then "hover"
			else "normal"
		image.Image = AssetView.resolve("ui.buttons." .. family .. "-" .. state) or image.Image
		image.ZIndex = button.ZIndex
		caption.ZIndex = button.ZIndex + 1
		caption.Text = button.Text
		caption.TextColor3 = button.TextColor3
		caption.FontFace = button.FontFace
		caption.TextScaled = button.TextScaled
		caption.TextSize = button.TextSize
		caption.TextWrapped = button.TextWrapped
		caption.TextXAlignment = button.TextXAlignment
		caption.TextYAlignment = button.TextYAlignment
		caption.TextStrokeTransparency = button.TextStrokeTransparency
		-- The separate caption remains visible even if a texture is still loading or rejected.
		caption.Visible = true
		button.TextTransparency = 1
	end
	for _, property in
		{
			"Text",
			"TextColor3",
			"FontFace",
			"TextScaled",
			"TextSize",
			"TextWrapped",
			"TextXAlignment",
			"TextYAlignment",
			"ZIndex",
		}
	do
		button:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property):Connect(sync)
	end
	button:GetAttributeChangedSignal("AssetDisabled"):Connect(sync)
	image:GetPropertyChangedSignal("IsLoaded"):Connect(sync)
	button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		hover = true
		sync()
	end)
	button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		hover = false
		pressed = false
		sync()
	end)
	button.SelectionGained:Connect(function()
		focused = true
		sync()
	end)
	button.SelectionLost:Connect(function()
		focused = false
		pressed = false
		sync()
	end)
	button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA
		then
			pressed = true
			sync()
		end
	end)
	-- Global release handles a pointer/finger leaving the button while pressed.
	local release = game:GetService("UserInputService").InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA
		then
			pressed = false
			sync()
		end
	end)
	button.Destroying:Connect(function()
		release:Disconnect()
	end)
	sync()
end

return AssetView

-- One shared safe-area observer. Native joystick graphics never drive HUD positions.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Solver = require(script.Parent.ControlLayout)
local Settings = require(script.Parent.ControlSettings)
local Layout = {}
local metricsArea: Frame?
local current: any = nil
local subscribers: { [ScreenGui]: (any) -> () } = {}
local queued = false
local jump: GuiObject?
local jumpConnections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}

function Layout.isTouch(): boolean
	return UserInputService.PreferredInput == Enum.PreferredInput.Touch
end
function Layout.configure(screen: ScreenGui, order: number?)
	screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screen.IgnoreGuiInset = false
	screen.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.CoreUISafeInsets
	screen.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	screen.DisplayOrder = order or 10
end
local function update()
	queued = false
	local area = metricsArea
	if not area or area.AbsoluteSize.X < 1 or area.AbsoluteSize.Y < 1 then
		return
	end
	local size, origin = area.AbsoluteSize, area.AbsolutePosition
	local native = nil
	if jump and jump.Parent and jump.AbsoluteSize.Y > 0 then
		local p, s = jump.AbsolutePosition - origin, jump.AbsoluteSize
		native = { x = p.X, y = p.Y, w = s.X, h = s.Y }
	end
	local mobile = Solver.solve(size.X, size.Y, native, Settings.get("size"))
	current = {
		size = size,
		origin = origin,
		touch = Layout.isTouch(),
		scale = math.clamp(math.min(size.X / 760, size.Y / 380), 0.85, 1.15),
		margin = 12,
		mobile = mobile,
		touchBottom = size.Y - mobile.jump.y + 10,
		vitalsBottom = size.Y - mobile.movement.y + 10,
	}
	for screen, apply in subscribers do
		if screen.Parent then
			apply(current)
		end
	end
end
local function schedule()
	if queued then
		return
	end
	queued = true
	task.defer(update)
end
local function watchJump(control: Instance)
	if control.Name ~= "JumpButton" or not control:IsA("GuiObject") or control == jump then
		return
	end
	for _, connection in jumpConnections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(jumpConnections)
	jump = control
	for _, property in { "AbsolutePosition", "AbsoluteSize" } do
		table.insert(jumpConnections, control:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property):Connect(schedule))
	end
	table.insert(
		jumpConnections,
		control.Destroying:Connect(function()
			jump = nil
			for _, connection in jumpConnections do
				connection:Disconnect()
			end
			table.clear(jumpConnections)
			schedule()
		end)
	)
	schedule()
end
local function initialize()
	if metricsArea then
		return
	end
	local gui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screen.Name = "HUDSafeArea"
	Layout.configure(screen, 0)
	local area = Instance.new("Frame")
	area.Name = "SafeAreaMetrics"
	area.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	area.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	area.Active = false
	area.Parent = screen
	metricsArea = area
	screen.Parent = gui
	area:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(schedule)
	area:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(schedule)
	UserInputService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("PreferredInput"):Connect(schedule)
	Settings.changed:connect(function(key)
		if key == "size" then
			schedule()
		end
	end)
	local native = gui:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
	if native then
		for _, control in native:GetDescendants() do
			watchJump(control)
		end
	end
	gui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(control)
		if control:FindFirstAncestor("TouchGui") then
			watchJump(control)
		end
	end)
	schedule()
end
function Layout.bind(screen: ScreenGui, apply: (any) -> ())
	initialize()
	subscribers[screen] = apply
	screen.Destroying:Once(function()
		subscribers[screen] = nil
	end)
	if current then
		apply(current)
	else
		schedule()
	end
	return metricsArea
end
function Layout.place(widget: GuiObject, r: Solver.Rect)
	widget.AnchorPoint = Vector2.zero
	widget.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(r.x, r.y)
	widget.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(r.w, r.h)
end
function Layout.limitText(label: TextLabel | TextButton, min: number?, max: number?)
	local limit = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
	limit.MinTextSize = min or 12
	limit.MaxTextSize = max or 24
	limit.Parent = label
end
return Layout
"},{"group":"UI","name":"ActionState","source":"--!strict
-- Multiple input sources may hold an action; releasing one must not release another.
local ActionState = {}
function ActionState.new(changed: (string, boolean) -> ())
	local sources: { [string]: { [any]: boolean } } = {}
	local state = {}
	function state.isDown(action: string): boolean
		return sources[action] ~= nil and next(sources[action]) ~= nil
	end
	function state.set(action: string, pressed: boolean, source: any)
		local before = state.isDown(action)
		local held = sources[action] or {}
		sources[action] = held
		held[source] = if pressed then true else nil
		local after = state.isDown(action)
		if before ~= after then
			changed(action, after)
		end
	end
	function state.clear()
		local old = sources
		sources = {}
		for action, held in old do
			if next(held) then
				changed(action, false)
			end
		end
	end
	return state
end
return ActionState
"},{"group":"UI","name":"ControlLayout","source":"--!strict
-- Pure geometry: all coordinates are relative to the CoreUISafeInsets content rectangle.
local ControlLayout = {}
export type Rect = { x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number }
local function rect(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number): Rect
	return { x = math.round(x), y = math.round(y), w = math.round(w), h = math.round(h) }
end
function ControlLayout.intersects(a: Rect, b: Rect, gap: number?): boolean
	local g = gap or 0
	return a.x < b.x + b.w + g
		and a.x + a.w + g > b.x
		and a.y < b.y + b.h + g
		and a.y + a.h + g > b.y
end
function ControlLayout.contains(r: Rect, x: number, y: number): boolean
	return x >= r.x and y >= r.y and x < r.x + r.w and y < r.y + r.h
end

function ControlLayout.solve(width: number, height: number, nativeJump: Rect?, enlargement: number?)
	local margin, gap = 12, 10
	local jump = nativeJump or rect(width - 95, height - 90, 70, 70)
	-- Reserve a stable envelope, never the thumbstick's moving graphics.
	local movement = rect(
		0,
		height - math.min(156, height * 0.48),
		math.min(190, width * 0.28),
		math.min(156, height * 0.48)
	)
	local profiles = {
		{ name = "tablet", button = 64, fire = 96, eligible = width >= 900 and height >= 540 },
		{ name = "phone", button = 58, fire = 84, eligible = width >= 640 and height >= 330 },
		{ name = "compact", button = 52, fire = 76, eligible = true },
	}
	local requested = math.clamp(enlargement or 1, 1, 1.2)
	local last: any = nil
	-- Prefer the requested target size; fall back to the regular size only if it cannot fit.
	for _, multiplier in { requested, 1 } do
		for _, profile in profiles do
			if not profile.eligible then
				continue
			end
			local size = math.round(profile.button * multiplier)
			local fireSize = math.round(profile.fire * multiplier)
			for _, placement in { "above", "beside" } do
				local fireX = width - margin - fireSize
				local fireY = math.min(height - margin - fireSize, jump.y - gap - fireSize)
				if placement == "beside" then
					fireX = math.min(width - margin - fireSize, jump.x - gap - fireSize)
					fireY = height - margin - fireSize
				end
				local gridRight = math.min(fireX, jump.x) - gap
				local gridX = gridRight - (size * 2 + gap)
				local gridY = height - margin - (size * 3 + gap * 2)
				local actions =
					{ Fire = rect(fireX, fireY, fireSize, fireSize) } :: { [string]: Rect }
				for i, name in { "Grenade", "Ability", "Aim", "Reload", "Melee", "Interact" } do
					actions[name] = rect(
						gridX + ((i - 1) % 2) * (size + gap),
						gridY + math.floor((i - 1) / 2) * (size + gap),
						size,
						size
					)
				end
				local ammoLeft, ammoRight = movement.w + margin, gridX - margin
				local ammoWidth = math.min(160, ammoRight - ammoLeft)
				local ammo = rect(
					ammoLeft + (ammoRight - ammoLeft - ammoWidth) / 2,
					height - 56,
					ammoWidth,
					44
				)
				local vitals =
					rect(margin, movement.y - 50, math.min(180, movement.w - margin * 2), 40)
				local bannerWidth = math.min(280, width - 240)
				local banner = rect((width - bannerWidth) / 2, 12, bannerWidth, 40)
				local boss = rect(banner.x, 56, banner.w, 14)
				local errors = {}
				local widgets = {
					Vitals = vitals,
					Ammo = ammo,
					Banner = banner,
					Boss = boss,
					Menu = rect(width - 100, 12, 88, 44),
					Class = rect(12, 12, 108, 44),
				} :: { [string]: Rect }
				for name, r in actions do
					widgets[name] = r
				end
				for name, r in widgets do
					if
						r.x < margin
						or r.y < margin
						or r.x + r.w > width - margin
						or r.y + r.h > height - margin
						or r.w <= 0
					then
						table.insert(errors, name .. ": bounds")
					end
					if
						name ~= "Class"
						and (
							ControlLayout.intersects(r, jump, 4)
							or ControlLayout.intersects(r, movement, 4)
						)
					then
						table.insert(errors, name .. ": native reservation")
					end
					for other, b in widgets do
						if name < other and ControlLayout.intersects(r, b, 4) then
							table.insert(errors, name .. "/" .. other)
						end
					end
				end
				if ammo.w < 92 then
					table.insert(errors, "Ammo: readable width")
				end
				last = {
					profile = profile.name,
					actions = actions,
					ammo = ammo,
					vitals = vitals,
					banner = banner,
					boss = boss,
					jump = jump,
					movement = movement,
					errors = errors,
					valid = #errors == 0,
					enlargement = multiplier,
					requestedEnlargement = requested,
					placement = placement,
				}
				if last.valid then
					return last
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return last
end
return ControlLayout
"},{"group":"UI","name":"TouchRouter","source":"--!strict
-- Pure ownership state. Used by both GUI input and the fire/camera pass-through.
local TouchRouter = {}
function TouchRouter.new()
	local touches: { [any]: any } = {}
	local controls: { [string]: any } = {}
	local router = {}
	function router.claim(touch: any, name: string, release: () -> ()): boolean
		if touches[touch] or controls[name] then
			return false
		end
		touches[touch] = { name = name, release = release }
		controls[name] = touch
		return true
	end
	function router.release(touch: any)
		local held = touches[touch]
		if not held then
			return
		end
		touches[touch] = nil
		controls[held.name] = nil
		held.release()
	end
	function router.cancel()
		for touch in table.clone(touches) do
			router.release(touch)
		end
	end
	return router
end
return TouchRouter

-- Local session preferences. No server data or combat balance is changed.
local Signal = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Util.Signal)
local Settings = {}
Settings.changed = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<string>
local defaults: { [string]: any } = {
	size = 1,
	transparency = 0.35,
	sensitivity = 1,
	aimSensitivity = 0.75,
	aimMode = "toggle",
	autoFire = true,
}
local values = table.clone(defaults)
function Settings.get(key: string): any
	return values[key]
end
function Settings.set(key: string, value: any)
	if defaults[key] == nil or values[key] == value then
		return
	end
	values[key] = value
	Settings.changed:fire(key)
end
function Settings.reset()
	for key, value in defaults do
		Settings.set(key, value)
	end
end
return Settings
"},{"group":"Controllers","name":"InputController","source":"--!strict
-- Single source of truth for player actions. Keyboard/mouse, gamepad and the touch HUD all
-- feed setAction(); gameplay code only reads isDown() / actionChanged and never cares which
-- device produced the input.

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local ActionState = require(script.Parent.Parent.UI.ActionState)
local Settings = require(script.Parent.Parent.UI.ControlSettings)
local Signal = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Util.Signal)

export type Action = "Fire" | "Aim" | "Reload" | "Ability" | "Interact" | "Grenade" | "Melee" | "Jump"

local InputController = {}

InputController.modalChanged = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<boolean>
InputController.panelRequested = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<string>
InputController.actionChanged = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<Action, boolean>

-- Auto-fire (fire when the crosshair is over a zombie) defaults on for touch; the targeting
-- check itself lands with the weapon system in week 4.
InputController.autoFire = false

InputController.cancelled = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<string>
local state = ActionState.new(function(action, pressed)
	InputController.actionChanged:fire(action :: Action, pressed)
end)
function InputController.cancelAll(reason: string)
	state.clear()
	InputController.cancelled:fire(reason)
end
local modals: { [string]: boolean } = {}
local closers: { [string]: () -> () } = {}

function InputController.registerModal(name: string, close: () -> ())
	closers[name] = close
end

function InputController.isTouch(): boolean
	return UserInputService.PreferredInput == Enum.PreferredInput.Touch
end

local KEY_BINDINGS: { [Enum.KeyCode | Enum.UserInputType]: Action } = {
	[Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1] = "Fire",
	[Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2] = "Aim",
	[Enum.KeyCode.R] = "Reload",
	[Enum.KeyCode.Q] = "Ability",
	[Enum.KeyCode.E] = "Interact",
	[Enum.KeyCode.G] = "Grenade",
	[Enum.KeyCode.V] = "Melee",
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2] = "Fire",
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL2] = "Aim",
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX] = "Reload",
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonY] = "Ability",
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB] = "Melee",
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1] = "Grenade",
	[Enum.KeyCode.DPadUp] = "Interact",
}

-- Menus (shop, class picker) register while open: the mouse is freed and weapons hold fire.
function InputController.setModal(name: string, open: boolean)
	if open then
		for other in table.clone(modals) do
			if other ~= name and closers[other] then
				closers[other]()
			end
		end
	end
	modals[name] = if open then true else nil
	if open then
		InputController.cancelAll("modal")
	end
	InputController.modalChanged:fire(InputController.isModalOpen())
end

function InputController.isModalOpen(): boolean
	return next(modals) ~= nil
end

function InputController.isDown(action: Action): boolean
	return state.isDown(action)
end

function InputController.setAction(action: Action, pressed: boolean, source: any?)
	if pressed and InputController.isModalOpen() then
		return
	end
	state.set(action, pressed, source or "legacy")
end

local function bindingFor(input: InputObject): Action?
	return KEY_BINDINGS[input.KeyCode] or KEY_BINDINGS[input.UserInputType]
end

function InputController.init()
	InputController.autoFire = Settings.get("autoFire")
	Settings.changed:connect(function(key)
		if key == "autoFire" then
			InputController.autoFire = Settings.get(key)
		end
	end)
end

function InputController.start()
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if processed or InputController.isModalOpen() then
			return
		end
		local action = bindingFor(input)
		if action then
			InputController.setAction(action, true, input)
		end
	end)

	-- Releases are never filtered by `processed`, otherwise an action could stay stuck down.
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		local action = bindingFor(input)
		if action then
			InputController.setAction(action, false, input)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
		InputController.cancelAll("focus")
	end)
	UserInputService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("PreferredInput"):Connect(function()
		InputController.cancelAll("input-device")
	end)
	GuiService.MenuOpened:Connect(function()
		InputController.setModal("Roblox", true)
	end)
	GuiService.MenuClosed:Connect(function()
		InputController.setModal("Roblox", false)
	end)
	game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
		InputController.cancelAll("character")
	end)
end

return InputController
"},{"group":"Controllers","name":"ProgressionHUD","source":"--!strict
-- Account level badge with an XP bar (top-left, under the CLASSE button), the active XP boost
-- countdown, and the VIP panel with the two Robux offers. Purchases are prompted here; the
-- server grants them (MonetizationService). Offers whose ids aren't configured yet show as
-- unavailable instead of failing.

local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local InputController = require(script.Parent.InputController)
local Theme = require(script.Parent.Parent.UI.Theme)
local Layout = require(script.Parent.Parent.UI.Layout)

local ProgressionHUD = {}

local M = Config.MONETIZATION

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local screen: ScreenGui
local badge: Frame
local vipButton: TextButton
local levelLabel: TextLabel
local xpFill: Frame
local boostLabel: TextLabel
local vipPanel: Frame
local packButton: TextButton
local boostButton: TextButton
local progressSummary: TextLabel

local function number(name: string, default: number): number
	local value = player:GetAttribute(name)
	return if typeof(value) == "number" then value else default
end

local function buildBadge()
	badge = Instance.new("Frame")
	badge.Name = "Level"
	badge.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 160)
	badge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(210, 40)
	Theme.panel(badge)
	badge.Parent = screen

	Theme.image(badge, "ui.icons.xp", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 5),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
		ImageColor3 = Theme.COLOR.accent,
	})
	levelLabel = Theme.text(badge, "heavy", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 3),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0, 20),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	})
	local back = Instance.new("Frame")
	back.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 26)
	back.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 7)
	back.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	back.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
	back.BorderSizePixel = 0
	back.Parent = badge
	xpFill = Instance.new("Frame")
	xpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.COLOR.accent
	xpFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	xpFill.Parent = back

	boostLabel = Theme.text(screen, "heavy", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 204),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 18),
		TextColor3 = Theme.COLOR.accent,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Visible = false,
	})
end

local function setVipOpen(open: boolean)
	vipPanel.Visible = open
	InputController.setModal("VIP", open)
end

local function offerRow(parent: Frame, y: number, title: string, description: string): TextButton
	Theme.text(parent, "heavy", {
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.06, y),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.1),
		Text = title,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	})
	Theme.text(parent, "label", {
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.06, y + 0.1),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.12),
		Text = description,
		TextColor3 = Theme.COLOR.muted,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	})
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	button.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.94, y + 0.02)
	button.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.16)
	Theme.button(button)
	button.Parent = parent
	return button
end

local function buildVip()
	local open = Instance.new("TextButton")
	vipButton = open
	open.Name = "VipButton"
	open.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 228)
	open.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(110, 32)
	open.Text = "★ VIP"
	Theme.button(open)
	open.Parent = screen
	open.Activated:Connect(function()
		setVipOpen(not vipPanel.Visible)
	end)

	vipPanel = Instance.new("Frame")
	vipPanel.Name = "VipPanel"
	vipPanel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	vipPanel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	vipPanel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	Theme.panel(vipPanel, 0.1)
	vipPanel.Visible = false
	vipPanel.Parent = screen
	local aspect = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
	aspect.AspectRatio = 1.5
	aspect:Destroy()

	Theme.text(vipPanel, "display", {
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.04),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.14),
		Text = "PROGRESSÃO",
		TextColor3 = Theme.COLOR.accent,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	})
	local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
	close.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	close.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.95, 0.05)
	close.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.14)
	close.Text = "X"
	Theme.button(close)
	close.Parent = vipPanel
	close.Activated:Connect(function()
		setVipOpen(false)
	end)

	progressSummary = Theme.text(vipPanel, "heavy", {
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.19),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.88, 0.07),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	})
	packButton = offerRow(
		vipPanel,
		0.30,
		"PACOTE DO SOBREVIVENTE",
		"Armas douradas e um rastro. Só visual — nada de vantagem."
	)
	boostButton = offerRow(
		vipPanel,
		0.60,
		"BOOST 2x XP — 1 HORA",
		"Dobra o XP de conta. Acumula se comprar de novo."
	)
	Theme.text(vipPanel, "label", {
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.9),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.88, 0.06),
		Text = "Nada à venda aumenta dano, vida ou dá armas exclusivas.",
		TextColor3 = Theme.COLOR.muted,
	})

	packButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if M.survivorPackId ~= 0 and player:GetAttribute("SurvivorPack") ~= true then
			MarketplaceService:PromptGamePassPurchase(player, M.survivorPackId)
		end
	end)
	boostButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if M.xpBoostProductId ~= 0 then
			MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(player, M.xpBoostProductId)
		end
	end)
end

local function clock(seconds: number): string
	local m = math.ceil(seconds / 60)
	return if m >= 60 then string.format("%dh%02d", m // 60, m % 60) else `{m} min`
end

-- Level and VIP are for the lobby, the camp and the breaks between waves; in combat they're
-- clutter next to health and ammo. Without a Match (the hub) they always show.
local function outOfCombat(): boolean
	local match = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Match")
	local phase = match and match:GetAttribute("Phase")
	return phase ~= "Wave" and phase ~= "Final" and phase ~= "Extract"
end

local function update()
	local calm = outOfCombat()
	badge.Visible = calm
		and not ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Match")
		and not InputController.isModalOpen()
	vipButton.Visible = false
	local level = number("Level", 1)
	local progress = number("LevelXP", 0)
	local needed = math.max(1, number("LevelXPNeeded", 100))
	levelLabel.Text = `NÍVEL {level}   {math.floor(progress)} / {needed} XP`
	progressSummary.Text = levelLabel.Text
	xpFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(progress / needed, 0, 1), 1)

	-- BoostUntil is os.time() on the server; server time on the client is the same clock.
	local boostLeft = number("BoostUntil", 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	boostLabel.Visible = badge.Visible and boostLeft > 0
	if boostLeft > 0 then
		boostLabel.Text = "2x XP — " .. clock(boostLeft)
	end

	local owned = player:GetAttribute("SurvivorPack") == true
	packButton.Text = if M.survivorPackId == 0
		then "EM BREVE"
		elseif owned then "ATIVO"
		else "COMPRAR"
	packButton.AutoButtonColor = false
	packButton:SetAttribute("AssetDisabled", M.survivorPackId == 0 or owned)
	packButton.TextColor3 = if M.survivorPackId == 0 or owned
		then Theme.COLOR.text
		else Theme.COLOR.panel
	boostButton.Text = if M.xpBoostProductId == 0 then "EM BREVE" else "COMPRAR"
	boostButton.AutoButtonColor = false
	boostButton:SetAttribute("AssetDisabled", M.xpBoostProductId == 0)
	boostButton.TextColor3 = if M.xpBoostProductId == 0 then Theme.COLOR.text else Theme.COLOR.panel
end

function ProgressionHUD.init()
	screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screen.Name = "ProgressionHUD"
	Layout.configure(screen, 40)
	buildBadge()
	buildVip()
	InputController.registerModal("VIP", function()
		setVipOpen(false)
	end)
	InputController.panelRequested:connect(function(name)
		if name == "Progression" then
			setVipOpen(true)
		end
	end)
end

function ProgressionHUD.start()
	screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	Layout.bind(screen, function(m)
		badge.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		badge.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, if m.touch then -m.vitalsBottom else -16)
		badge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(if m.touch then 190 else 240, 48)
		boostLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
		boostLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, if m.touch then -m.vitalsBottom - 52 else -70)
		vipPanel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(620, m.size.X - 24), math.min(440, m.size.Y - 20))
	end)
	local match = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Match")
	if match then
		match:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Phase"):Connect(function()
			setVipOpen(false)
		end)
	end
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(update)
end

return ProgressionHUD
"},{"group":"Controllers","name":"MenuController","source":"--!strict
-- Responsive scrolling settings keep every option reachable in short landscape viewports.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Input = require(script.Parent.InputController)
local Theme = require(script.Parent.Parent.UI.Theme)
local Layout = require(script.Parent.Parent.UI.Layout)
local Settings = require(script.Parent.Parent.UI.ControlSettings)
local Menu = {}
local screen: ScreenGui
local panel: Frame
local openButton: TextButton
local list: ScrollingFrame
local detail: TextLabel
local closeButton: TextButton
local mobileRows: { TextButton } = {}
local labels: { () -> () } = {}
local enlargedFits = true
local function setOpen(open: boolean)
	panel.Visible = open
	Input.setModal("Menu", open)
end
local function button(text: string, parent: Instance): TextButton
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Text = text
	b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 48)
	Theme.button(b, "secondary")
	Layout.limitText(b, 14, 21)
	b.Parent = parent
	return b
end
local function option(key: string, values: { any }, describe: () -> string)
	local b = button("", list)
	table.insert(mobileRows, b)
	table.insert(labels, function()
		b.Text = describe()
	end)
	b.Activated:Connect(function()
		local index = table.find(values, Settings.get(key)) or 1
		Settings.set(key, values[index % #values + 1])
	end)
end
local function refresh()
	local touch = Input.isTouch()
	openButton.Visible = not Input.isModalOpen()
	for _, row in mobileRows do
		row.Visible = touch
	end
	for _, apply in labels do
		apply()
	end
	detail.Text = if touch
		then "Segure ATIRAR e arraste para acompanhar o alvo.\nAnalógico e pulo são do Roblox. Ajustes valem nesta sessão.\nA partida online continua com o menu aberto."
		else "WASD: mover · Mouse: tiro / mira\nR: recarga · Q: habilidade · G: granada\nV: corpo a corpo · E: interagir · Espaço: pular"
end
function Menu.init()
	screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screen.Name = "GameMenu"
	Layout.configure(screen, 40)
	openButton = button("MENU", screen)
	openButton.Name = "MenuButton"
	panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.Name = "Menu"
	panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	panel.Active = true
	Theme.panel(panel, 0.05)
	panel.Visible = false
	panel.Parent = screen
	Theme.text(
		panel,
		"display",
		{
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 8),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 32),
			Text = "MENU E CONTROLES",
		}
	)
	list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	list.Name = "Options"
	list.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 48)
	list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	list.BorderSizePixel = 0
	list.ScrollBarThickness = 5
	list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
	list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	list.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
	list.Parent = panel
	local flow = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	flow.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
	flow.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	flow.Parent = list
	button("PROGRESSÃO E COSMÉTICOS", list).Activated:Connect(function()
		setOpen(false)
		Input.panelRequested:fire("Progression")
	end)
	option("size", { 1, 1.2 }, function()
		return "TAMANHO: "
			.. (
				if Settings.get("size") == 1
					then "PADRÃO"
					elseif enlargedFits then "AMPLIADO"
					else "AUTO — LIMITE DA TELA"
			)
	end)
	option("transparency", { 0.15, 0.35, 0.55 }, function()
		return "OPACIDADE: "
			.. tostring(math.round((1 - Settings.get("transparency")) * 100))
			.. "%"
	end)
	option("sensitivity", { 0.75, 1, 1.25 }, function()
		return "CÂMERA: " .. tostring(Settings.get("sensitivity")) .. "×"
	end)
	option("aimSensitivity", { 0.5, 0.75, 1 }, function()
		return "CÂMERA AO MIRAR: " .. tostring(Settings.get("aimSensitivity")) .. "×"
	end)
	option("aimMode", { "toggle", "hold" }, function()
		return "MIRA: "
			.. (if Settings.get("aimMode") == "toggle" then "TOCAR PARA ALTERNAR" else "SEGURAR")
	end)
	option("autoFire", { true, false }, function()
		return "DISPARO AUTOMÁTICO: "
			.. (if Settings.get("autoFire") then "LIGADO" else "DESLIGADO")
	end)

local function toast(message: string)
	toastToken += 1
	local token = toastToken
	toastLabel.Text = message
	toastLabel.TextTransparency = 0
	task.delay(3, function()
		if token == toastToken then
			TweenService:Create(toastLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.5), { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
		end
	end)

end

local function update()
	local map = player:GetAttribute("PortalMap")
	local queued = typeof(map) == "string"
	local visible = not Input.isModalOpen()
	panel.Visible = queued and visible
	campTitle.Visible = not queued and visible
	campHint.Visible = campTitle.Visible
	if not panel.Visible then
		return
	end
	mapLabel.Text = map :: string
	local count = player:GetAttribute("PortalCount")
	local max = player:GetAttribute("PortalMax")
	local endsAt = player:GetAttribute("PortalEndsAt")
	local left = if typeof(endsAt) == "number" and endsAt > 0
		then endsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		else 0
	groupLabel.Text = string.format(
		"GRUPO %s/%s — DECOLA EM %s",
		tostring(count or 1),
		tostring(max or 4),
		clock(left)
	)

	screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screen.Name = "PortalHUD"
	Layout.configure(screen, 10)
	build()
end

	screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	Layout.bind(screen, function(m)
		campTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 12)
		campTitle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(320, m.size.X * 0.5), 36)

		panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, if not m.touch and m.size.X < 900 then -88 else -16)
	end)
	TeleportService:SetTeleportGui(loadingScreen())
	player.OnTeleport:Connect(function(state)
		if state == Enum.TeleportState.Started or state == Enum.TeleportState.InProgress then
			if not teleportOverlay then
				teleportOverlay = loadingScreen()
				teleportOverlay.DisplayOrder = 80
				teleportOverlay.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
			end
		end
	end)
	TeleportService.TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(failedPlayer)
		if failedPlayer == player and teleportOverlay then
			teleportOverlay:Destroy()
			teleportOverlay = nil
		end
	end)
	Net.notify().OnClientEvent:Connect(function(message: unknown)
		if typeof(message) == "string" then
			toast(message)
		end
	end)
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(update)
end

return PortalHUD
